text:
maria: :rotating_light: paging integration to PagerX failing — automated pages not being delivered since ~13:02 UTC. I saw 2 missed escalations and incident-bot shows 'delivered=false' in webhook logs. Raising here so on-call can coordinate.

alex: on it. are we seeing HTTP 5xx from pagerx or our webhook service?

maria: logs show 502 gateway from pagerx-proxy for the last 6m. Sample: `POST /webhook/pagerx 502` and then `incidents:delivery=failed` in our notify-bus logs.

incident-bot: [system] Alert created: INC-2026-1872. PagerX delivery failure. Initial page attempted to oncall@sre (policy:sre-primary) at 13:03 UTC — status: failed.

lee: I can toggle the fallback route to our secondary notifier (pagerflow) manually. Will do 13:08 UTC and monitor.

sam: thanks. if we flip fallback, we should manual-page high-severity pages until we confirm delivery. can someone DM the oncall to check phone? @alex please.

alex: pinging oncall now. (reacts: :phone:)

ops-bot: automation:notify-routes — current_state: primary=pagerx (unhealthy), fallback=pagerflow (enabled=false), failover_reason=none.

lee: running command to enable fallback:```sh
# enable pagerflow fallback
curl -X POST 'https://ops-api.internal/v1/routes/fallback' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"target":"pagerflow","enabled":true}'
```

lee: fallback enabled at 13:10 UTC. ops-bot confirms: fallback=pagerflow enabled=true.

incident-bot: [system] Retrying deliveries via fallback route. 3 queued pages retried at 13:11 UTC.

maria: manual check with PagerFlow shows deliveries succeeded (200) for two pages. customers affected: customer-a, customer-b.

alex: quick postmortem data point: how many pages failed to escalate to human oncall? I see 2 missed ack windows (13:03 & 13:07) that would have escalated to pager oncall.

maria: confirmed — 2 missed high-severity pages, both for live customer incidents (latency spikes). Impact: delayed oncall acknowledgement by ~6-9m. no customer-facing outage beyond transient latency, but support got two delayed escalations.

sam: are these customers on Dedicated? we should check Dedicated routing policy (different webhook).

lee: both on Hosted API, route goes to PagerX. Dedicated routes are unaffected.

alex: root cause hypothesis: PagerX temporarily returning 502s causing our notify-bus to mark deliveries as failed; automation didn't auto-enable fallback due to a throttle bug in failover controller (it only flips after 5 consecutive failures but our controller mis-counted).

maria: I see the throttle bug in the controller logs: `failover_controller: consecutive_failures_count reset unexpectedly when concurrent retry happened` — patch queued.

sam: mitigation steps taken: 1) manual enable fallback (done), 2) manual re-trigger of queued pages (done), 3) notify affected customers and support (maria), 4) patch queued to controller repo and will roll canary (lee).

alex: can we add temporary alert rule to detect delivery=false > 1 and auto-failover immediately until patch is live?

lee: yes i'll add a short-lived rule and roll it in after canary.

incident-bot: [system] Incident INC-2026-1872 acknowledged by alex at 13:15 UTC.

maria: customer impact note for postmortem: two delayed pages, delayed ack 6-9m, customers saw transient latency. no data loss. notif channel: support-ticket #SUP-412 & #SUP-413 opened.

sam: post-incident followups: - revert short-lived alert after patch - add unit test for failover counter race - update runbook to include manual fallback instructions and Slack slash command `/notify fallback enable`

lee: patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/failover-controller/pull/324 (link shared). Canaries starting 13:40 UTC.

alex: good. after canary and alert rule change, follow up with exec summary. I will own the postmortem doc.

maria: thanks all. small ask: add a line in runbook about explicitly confirming page delivery with `notify-bus status <incident-id>` before assuming fallback succeeded. saved us some confusion.

ops-bot: action items logged — #A1 enable fallback (manual), #A2 patch controller, #A3 create alert rule, #A4 update runbook.

lee: final note: PagerX is reachable now; monitoring shows stable 200s since 13:22 UTC. will keep watch for 30m before closing incident.

maria: closing updates: support notified, customers acked, postmortem owner alex. leaving incident open until canary completes. (reacts: :white_check_mark:)
